q1_issues.issue: (Possession sk_effort_1 sk_republican_1) reads the attributive modifier "Republican" as a possessor, but the Possession route requires an 's, a possessive pronoun, or a genitive of-phrase — none is present, so this asserts a link the text does not state.

A group of Republican persons is minted purely from the adjectival modifier of "efforts"; combined with statements 3 and 4 the single word "Republican" is encoded three ways at once (a person group, a possessor link, and a distributed property of each effort), and `republican` is used both as a person kind and as a property of efforts.
The second argument of the To relation is a sealed (Or (And ...) (And ...)) term rather than an eventuality symbol; the connective/noun-complement forms relate reified eventualities by symbol.

The disjunction is scoped over two whole event bundles although only the verb class varies — the instruction set requires scoping (Or ...) as narrowly as possible around the varying constituent and keeping the shared Agent and Theme as ordinary conjuncts.

The force and entice events exist only inside the sealed To term, so neither event class nor its roles is reachable at top level, while the return event they govern is asserted at top level — an asymmetry the text does not motivate.

q2_gaps: a bare plural NP in a non-subject, specific-reference position ("part of failed Republican efforts") — the bare-plural-is-generic rule is stated for plural SUBJECTS, so there is no stated route for a bare plural that denotes a particular set

a noun's to-infinitive complement ("efforts TO force ...") — the noun-complement section covers of-phrases and "for" arguments but not a to-infinitive on a nominalization, and it is not the purpose-infinitive case either since there is no main clause action
coordinated (disjoined) verbs inside a sealed / unasserted complement — the Disjunction section scopes Or inside an asserted (And ...) fact, and gives no shape for an Or under a relation argument
notes: The definite-plural group witnesses (fines, Democrats), the participle-as-adjective `failed`, the member-distribution rule shape and STV, and the object-control treatment of "force the Democrats to return" (complement at top level with no tense, controller copied in as Agent) all follow the instruction set. The defect mass is the triple encoding of "Republican" and the structure of the To atom.
